task: ae.tsdb compressed time-series store: Gorilla delta-of-delta/XOR codec, block-skipping queries, aggregates, retention, CRC snapshot
reasoning_summary: Designed a bit-level Gorilla codec (delta-of-delta timestamps, XOR floats with window reuse) under a block store with min/max block skipping, NaN-ignoring aggregates, whole-block retention and a CRC32 snapshot with structural validation. Tests were written first: bit-stream and codec tables, randomized round trips with special doubles, naive-model query oracles, truncation/flip corruption loops and re-sealed bad images. The first run had 2 wrong hand-computed block-boundary expectations in tests; fixing the fixtures gave 35 passing tests, and two mutations of the codec were caught.
